about: Per-stock build recipe for tools/film_profiles/build.py, as data/profile-sources/fujifilm-pfdg/recipe.json; see README.md. Sources: Fujifilm Japan's film data sheets (fujifilm.com/jp/ja/consumer/support/films/negative-and-reversal/datasheet). rms_granularity is the sheet's diffuse RMS granularity (48 um aperture, D 1.0 over D-min). Characteristic curves: daylight 1/125 s, CN-16X, status M; sensitivity: status M, D-min + 1.0.

fujifilm_superia_venus_800.name: Fujifilm Superia Venus 800
fujifilm_superia_venus_800.datasheet_heading: フジカラー SUPERIA Venus 800, ISO 800/30°, daylight; sold outside Japan as SUPERIA X-TRA 800
notes: the datasheet's dashed fourth colour layer (第4の感色層, cyan-sensitive) is not modelled: the three-layer model takes the blue, green and red sensitive layers only
fujifilm_superia_venus_800.check6_fallback: the §D3 fallback (a flat extension past 700 nm) was not tried, as the worst point is not near 700 nm

source.document: FUJICOLOR SUPERIA Venus 800 product information bulletin (Japanese), Ref. No. 013AR284A

y.gate_reason: hand-drafted grid reused across Fujifilm Japan's data sheets (Venus 800 and Natura 1600 share the dye chart's residuals to 0.001 %): no straight axis reproduces the gridlines within 0.2 % (worst 0.22 %, 0.0089 D). The extraction error is bounded by that residual whether the curves were drawn to the true scale or to the drawn grid. Physical check: Natura 1600 from these sheets against the independent Professional Film Data Guide AF3-207U trace of the same emulsion (Superia 1600): curves within 0.009 D, spectra within 0.021 D (README, calibration/natura_1600_vs_pfdg_superia_1600_curves.json, calibration/vs_pfdg_all_panels.json).

y.relative_reason: Relative sensitivity (log), no tick values: a 1.0 scale bar spans the two gridlines (one log unit). The offset is arbitrary; D5 rescales every channel so it does not reach the profile.
